b = last_transition.before_frame.segmentation['nodes']
a = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
def sig(nodes):
    return {n['id']:(n['color'],n['pixels'],n['boundary']) for n in nodes}
sb, sa = sig(b), sig(a)
for i,n in enumerate(a):
    key = (n['color'], n['pixels'], n['boundary'])
    # find matching in before by color+pixels
    match = [j for j,x in sb.items() if x[0]==n['color'] and x[1]==n['pixels']]
    if not match:
        print("NEW", i, n['color'], n['pixels'], n['boundary'])
    else:
        # check boundary changed
        moved = [j for j in match if sb[j][2]!=n['boundary']]
        if moved:
            print("MOVED", i, n['color'], sb[moved[0]][2], "->", n['boundary'])
# also check disappeared
used = set()
for i,n in enumerate(a):
    for j,x in sb.items():
        if x[0]==n['color'] and x[1]==n['pixels'] and x[2]==n['boundary']:
            used.add(j)
for j,x in sb.items():
    if j not in used:
        print("GONE", j, x)
